data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Chetu holds immense spiritual significance as it is associated with Lord Vishnu, the Preserver and protector of the universe. Possessing knowledge and wisdom is considered a divine quality, enabling one to fulfill their spiritual duties and lead a virtuous life. The name encourages the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom as a means of self-discovery and enlightenment.
